Class Room

  • java.lang.Object
    • Room
  • public class Room
extends Object
    A "Room" represents one location in the scenery of the game.It is connected to the other rooms via exits. This class is part of the "Photo with Icon" application. "Photo with Icon" is a very simple, text based adventure game inherited from "World of Zuul" application. The exits are labelled north, east, south, west. For each direction, the room stores a reference to the neighboring room, or null if there is no exit in that direction.
    Version:
    2008.03.30 + 2013.09.15 + 27.05.2022
    Author:
    Michael Kolling and David J. Barnes + D.Bureau + Danylo Dembitskyi
